cases.context: Inspect the release conditions one by one. The checker reads local files and reports gaps; it never executes a command or publishes anything.
cases.readout: Eight explicit gates cover scope, spec, evaluation, runbook, recorded checks, limitations, target and an approval record. Use the CLI with your own manifest for an actual project.

method: Each scenario is a labelled fixture manifest passed through release_check.py. Gate results are computed, not hard-coded success labels.
Paths must resolve to nonempty files within the project root. Missing artifacts, pending checks, blank limitations and public intent without an approval record fail their corresponding checks.
WORKFLOW.md provides the personal lifecycle. templates/release.json starts pending so copying the template cannot automatically certify a release.
limits: This is a manifest linter, not CI, a cryptographic attestation, an evaluator of LLM quality or authorization to perform actions.
The fixture evidence deliberately contains no real test certification. Use genuine dated outputs for a real project, and review their contents and freshness.
